arcs.title: The Briefcase
arcs.summary: Day 1: The glowing briefcase, circulating through Ministry corridors since late August, was observed Monday morning in the office of the Sub-Division Head of the Charmed Object Sub-Division. He declined to open it. It has been placed on a shelf. The shelf is warm. Day 2 should develop its circulation — perhaps it moves overnight, or a second Ministry official is found in proximity to it, or its glow changes colour in the presence of a specific person.
